sloka: हतो योजनबाहुश्च कबन्धो रुधिराशनः।क्रोधान्नादं नदन् सो ऽथ पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम् ।। ६.९५.१६ ।।
transliteration: hato yojanabāhuśca kabandho rudhirāśanaḥ।krodhānnādaṁ nadan so 'tha paryāptaṁ tannidarśanam ।। 6.95.16 ।।

translations.english: "Khara was killed in that combat with sunlike arrows, so also Dooshana and Trisira. That example is sufficient proof."
